name: Horizont
source:
The Earth has suffered from terrible wars, and the United Nations' World Federation Government was formed as a result. 33 years later ULF (United LUNA Front) has emerged and declared inter-planetary war to UNWF. The Moon gains initiative and transfers battlefield to the Earth.

In the meantime, there is a group of self-described pirates "E-Freeze" in the sea near Antarctica. They have technical skills comparable to "ULF" and ability to fight in any environment with their humanoid all-purpose weapon GrastX. Main character starts as a member of these pirates.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
地球经历可怕战争后，联合国世界联邦政府成立。33年后，地月联合阵线出现，向联合国世界联邦政府宣告星际战争。月球取得主动权，将战场转移到地球。

与此同时，南极附近海域有一群自称“E-Freeze”的海盗。他们的技术可与地月联合阵线匹敌，并能使用人形万能兵器“格拉斯特X”在任何环境作战。主人公从成为这群海盗的一员开始故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
